triple-loop.tagline: One short reading a day from the Old Testament, New Testament and Wisdom books
facts: Three tracks, each at its own pace
how: Only the track you read advances; the three are independent
Come back whenever you stop; never worry about missing a day
When a track reaches its last chapter, it loops back to its start
triple-loop.detail: For building a first habit, or returning to God's Word in a low-pressure, sustainable way. Each track advances one chapter a day by default; you can move ahead from any chapter page, or reset to the default progress at any time.

nt-deep-repeat.tagline: Read the same New Testament passage again and again until it sinks in
how: The New Testament in 52 stages of 4–6 chapters
Stay on one stage for 7, 14 or 28 days
One Old Testament chapter a day alongside
nt-deep-repeat.detail: Based on John MacArthur's New Testament reading method. “N readings” means staying on each stage for N days; 52 stages make one cycle of about 12 months, 2 years or 4 years. Come back whenever you stop; if you are new to Bible reading, start with Path 1.
